name: Buon Ma Thuot Coffee Festival
nameVi: Lễ hội Cà phê Buôn Ma Thuột
summary: A March festival on October 10 Square, Quảng trường 10 tháng 3. The ninth edition ran 9–13 March 2025, opening at 20:00 on 10 March and closing at 20:00 on 13 March. The Dak Lak provincial government says it is held every two years. A visitor pass is Check on arrival.
when: 9–13 March 2025. Opening 20:00 on 10 March and closing 20:00 on 13 March at October 10 Square. Later dates are Check on arrival.
